novelty_basis: A direct combination of Theorem 1(b) with the index/period structure of cyclic semigroups; likely folklore.
proof_check: written proof (proofs/paper/C15.md Theorem 3); implementation agrees with direct simulation for three commutative semigroups (EXP-C15-03); awaiting independent skeptic review
statement: For a finite commutative semigroup and t >= 2L + iota + 1 (iota the largest index of an element), cell i of a cyclic row at time t is prod_j r_(i+j)^(N_j), where N_j are the coefficients of (1 + S)^t mod S^L - 1, and only N_j modulo the lcm of the element periods is needed.
title: Commutative semigroups - fast-forward by exponent arithmetic
